title: Kitchen
summary: KITCH'EN, noun [Latin coquina; from the root of Latin coquo, to cook.] 1. A cook-room; the room of a house appropriated to cookery. A fat kitchen makes a lean will. 2. In ships, the galley or caboose.

inlines.v: KITCH'EN, noun [Latin coquina; from the root of Latin coquo, to cook.] 1. A cook-room; the room of a house appropriated to cookery. A fat kitchen makes a lean will. 2. In ships, the galley or caboose. 3. A utensil for roasting meat; as a tin kitchen
